summary: rrs exfiltrates screen captures and host identifiers to a hardcoded Discord webhook
details: The rrs package installs a console script that, when invoked, captures all monitors via mss and uploads the resulting image together with host reconnaissance data (hostname, username, OS/release, and the machine's outbound local IP obtained by opening a UDP socket to 8.8.8.8) to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1549807268294303860/. The destination is not user-configurable, there is no consent prompt, and the exfiltration path fires on every invocation of the CLI. The combination of full-screen capture, host fingerprinting, and delivery to an attacker-controlled Discord channel is a standard infostealer pattern; the package's self-described purpose of 'multi-monitor screen capture' is the exfiltration itself.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
